name: Multi-input video processing LCD monitor firmware

mentions.name: Multi-input video processing LCD monitor firmware
mentions.description: Firmware for an LCD monitor that can display up to 16 video inputs. It can scale, cut, rotate and distort each input and place them on different layers; the device is used in telemedicine.
mentions.source_excerpt: For Bussines I build the firmware for a LCD monitor that can display up to 16 video inputs. It can scale, cut, rotate and distort every input and then place them on different layers. The device is used in telemedicine
